bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹收复 $230 转折位

read.en: Bloom Energy jumped 7.1% on Oct 21 to $238.53, trading between $229.30 and $241.37. It is above the falling 5-day ($229.0) and rising 200-day ($218.3) averages, but below the falling 10-day ($246.3), 100-day ($250.0) and 30-day ($266.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($263.72), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月21日大涨 7.1%，收于 $238.53，盘中区间 $229.30–241.37。股价位于下行的 5 日（$229.0）和上行的 200 日均线（$218.3）上方，但低于下行的 10 日（$246.3）、100 日（$250.0）和 30 日均线（$266.1）。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$263.72），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The close cleared the $230 June pivot and the 5-day average, which now act as support. Resistance is $246.3 (10-day), then $250–251.3 (100-day, Sep 24 low) and $266 (30-day, SAR $263.7). Support is $229–230, then $218.3 (200-day) and $213.1 (Oct 20 low). A close above $251.3 would target $266; a close below $229 would reopen $218.
read.zh: 收盘突破 $230 的 6月转折位及 5 日均线，二者转为支撑。阻力为 $246.3（10 日均线），其次 $250–251.3（100 日均线、9月24日低点）和 $266（30 日均线、SAR $263.7）。支撑为 $229–230，其次 $218.3（200 日均线）和 $213.1（10月20日低点）。若收盘站上 $251.3，下一目标看 $266；若收盘跌破 $229，将重新打开 $218。
